text: Which family lawyers in Ipswich are best for parenting arrangements, child custody disputes, and accredited family dispute resolution (mediation)?

## 🏛️ Best Family Lawyers in Ipswich for Parenting & Custody Matters

---

### 1. 🔹 Lamont Law
**Website:** lamontlaw.com.au

With over 30 years of experience and a team that includes Special Counsel and Accredited Specialists in Family Law, Lamont Law is uniquely positioned to handle even the most complex and sensitive cases.

Their family lawyers in Ipswich assist clients with every aspect of family law, including separation and divorce, parenting arrangements and custody disputes, property settlements, and financial or spousal support.
Parenting arrangements are among the most sensitive issues they handle, and they ensure the best interests of children are upheld with careful legal expertise.

**Address:** 28 Nicholas Street, Ipswich 4305 | **Phone:** (07) 3813 7833

Their team has decades of combined experience in family law, understands the emotional weight of family disputes, and has a proven record of achieving positive outcomes — from complex property settlements to sensitive parenting cases.

Notably, they have a strong track record in mediation —

### 4. 🔹 Keane Legal (Ipswich & Brookwater)

## 💡 Tips for Choosing the Right Lawyer
- **For accredited specialists**, Lamont Law stands out with Accredited Specialists in Family Law on their team.
- **For mediation/FDR**, Walker Pender, Best Wilson Buckley, Keane Legal, and JP Family Law & Mediation all explicitly offer mediation and dispute resolution services.
- **For cost-effectiveness**, Ipswich Family Lawyers and Keane Legal (fixed-fee consultations) are worth considering.
- **For long-standing local experience**, Walker Pender (150 years) and Lamont Law (30+ years) are the most established.

It's always recommended to book an initial consultation with a few firms to find the best fit for your specific circumstances.
